verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: API push notifications that notify an application when watched resources change, and developer-guide examples of what an app could be built to do (create files from Form submissions, modify files in bulk, build an agent add-on). None of this is a user-facing Drive feature for setting up autonomous background automations, so under the partial-credit boundary it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
